summary: Full E2E testing of PUT /api/transactions/{tid} edit feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass covering historical price preservation, stock delta adjustment (+ inventory_history type='edit' with reason mentioning txn number), edited_by field, empty items 400, all-zero qty 400, add-new-item 400, insufficient stock 400, qty=0 removal returning stock. Frontend: pencil icon (txn-edit-<id>) opens 'Edit Transaksi <TRX-...>' dialog with all required data-testids (edit-customer, edit-payment, edit-discount, edit-cash, edit-total, edit-cancel, edit-save, edit-item-<pid>, edit-item-inc/dec/qty/note/remove-<pid>). Verified: +/- buttons and direct typing update edit-total live (Rp 26.000 -> Rp 52.000 -> Rp 78.000). Save shows toast 'Transaksi berhasil diperbarui', dialog closes, row reflects new qty (1->2) and total (Rp 26.000->Rp 52.000), and 'diedit' badge appears. Removing all items and clicking Simpan shows frontend guard toast 'Transaksi harus punya minimal 1 item'. Receipt regression: txn-view-<id> still opens dialog with Tutup/JPG/PNG/Cetak buttons and receipt-preview at exactly 302px.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend historical-price preservation is correct: server.py:539-544 reuses old line item's price/cost_price, so accounting stays accurate even if product prices change later.
Stock delta approach (server.py:503-533) is correct and idempotent-friendly; inventory_history entry uses type='edit' and reason includes transaction_number as required.
Frontend guard in Transactions.jsx:65 correctly blocks save when zero kept items, matching backend 400 message.
Minor: transaction_number regeneration uses count_documents+1 (server.py:434); on concurrent creates this could collide, but not related to edit feature.
Minor a11y: Edit dialog missing DialogDescription (Radix warning), non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_EDIT transactions during pytest run; edited TRX-20260902-00018 via UI (qty 1->2). Product stock adjustments are correctly reflected via inventory_history type='edit'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Edit-transaction feature fully working end-to-end. Backend endpoint PUT /api/transactions/{tid} at server.py:484-580. Frontend at Transactions.jsx uses edit dialog with data-testids as spec. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_transaction_edit.py can be reused as regression.
